description: This file defines an interface class `IOmiProxy` within the `omi` namespace, which provides methods for managing crypted bundles, such as mounting and unmounting, and for registering/unregistering error listeners. The interface is intended to abstract the underlying omi_dbus_api and facilitate signal handling and error reporting in OCIContainer-related code.

classes.name: IOmiProxy
classes.description: Interface class providing methods to interact with crypted bundle management and error handling in omi.

methods.name: mountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Mounts a crypted bundle given container ID, filesystem image path, and config JSON path; outputs the path to the decrypted config.

methods.name: umountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Unmounts the crypted bundle identified by the container ID.

methods.name: registerListener
methods.description: Registers an error listener callback; returns a listener ID for later unregistration.

methods.name: unregisterListener
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered listener using its ID.

ctags.name: OmiErrorListener
ctags.pattern: /^    typedef std::function<void(const std::string&, ErrorType, const void*)> OmiErrorListener;$/
